summary: Feed s090_single to IDS is degraded due to high encrypted share (71.8% vs 60% tolerance). IDS payload visibility is reduced; all other visibility checks (duplicates, one-way, drops, overload, VLAN) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: 71.8% of bytes are encrypted/TLS, exceeding the IDS 60% tolerance. Traffic is being forwarded to the IDS still encrypted with no upstream decryption/visibility appliance, so payload is opaque to signatures.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS needs full payload for signature and anomaly detection. With ~72% encrypted, the IDS is blind to exploits, malware and C2 inside TLS sessions, significantly reducing detection coverage.

recommended_fix.why: IDS cannot inspect encrypted payload itself; add selective TLS decryption/visibility in the packet broker path (decrypt zone) and forward cleartext to IDS where policy/compliance allows, bringing encrypted share below 60% and restoring payload inspection.
